subject: Project provisioning & API seats — handoff to Implementation Squad
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@opsly.health>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai; monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: onboard@opsly.health
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Getting started — Opsly project provisioning

Thanks Rishi — excited to get going. Quick context: Opsly needs one production workspace and two sandboxes (dev + staging). Key asks from our side:
- API seats for 5 service accounts (separate keys)
- Role mapping: Admin, Dev, ReadOnly for internal Opsly users
- Short-lived keys for integrations with our ETL job

Can you confirm who from Redwood will own the implementation handoff so we can line up our IT and procurement folks? I attached the scoping sheet with the current environment names.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Integrations — Opsly Health

Attachment: opsly_scoping_sheet.xlsx (excel/xlsx, 52KB)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@opsly.health>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Getting started — Opsly project provisioning

Samira — thanks for the scoping sheet, looks clean. Monica will lead the implementation and Ben will cover API key seeding and automation. Proposed immediate next steps:

1) Implementation kickoff (45m): Monica + Opsly IT + Samira — schedule this week
2) Provide project names + admin list (Opsly) — required to create workspaces
3) Redwood to seed initial API keys for 2 service accounts (dev/staging) for validation
4) Finalize role mappings and short-lived key TTLs during kickoff

Monica — can you confirm availability for a kickoff Thursday or Friday? Ben — I attached the initial API key template for Opsly to review post-kickoff.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Principal CS Manager — Redwood Inference

Attachment: initial_api_key_template.txt (text/plain, 1.2KB)

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@opsly.health>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 10:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Getting started — Opsly project provisioning

Samira / Rishi — I can do Thursday 11/23 09:00–10:00 PT or Friday 11/24 11:00–11:45 PT. For the kickoff, I'll cover:
- Workspace creation flow and naming conventions
- Admin & role bootstrap (how we map Admin/Dev/ReadOnly)
- API key lifecycle and recommended TTLs for short-lived tokens
- Demo: seeding keys via automation (Ben will demo)

Please add Opsly IT and procurement to the invite; if procurement needs pricing or SOW details we'll loop Rishi.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead — Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@opsly.health>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@opsly.health, onboard@opsly.health
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Getting started — Opsly project provisioning

Thursday 11/23 09:00 PT works for Opsly IT. I'm looping procurement for any contract/PO questions. Agenda request: please include the API key rotation plan and an example of how Redwood's role-based access shows up in the console (screenshare).

Procurement — we may need a short SOW and an initial invoice for reserved seats — Rishi will confirm.

Thanks,
Samira

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@opsly.health>, monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 24 Nov 2028 08:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Getting started — Opsly project provisioning

Hi all — following the kickoff (thanks everyone) here are the concrete tech actions I'm taking this week:

- Create workspaces: opsly-prod, opsly-staging, opsly-dev (expected completion: 11/24 EOD PT)
- Seed service accounts and generate initial API keys for opsly-dev and opsly-staging for validation
- Post keys to secure share link and flag for rotation after validation (default TTL suggested: 12 hours for integration tokens)
- Share a short playbook for automated seeding via our CI (implementation_checklist.md)

Samira — expect the secure link with keys and the checklist by 15:00 PT today. If Opsly requires more than 5 seats, let me know before EOD and I’ll expand.

Best,
Ben Carter
Platform Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachment: implementation_checklist.md (markdown, 3.4KB)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@opsly.health>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@opsly.health
Date: Fri, 24 Nov 2028 15:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Getting started — Opsly project provisioning

Received — thank you Ben. We validated the dev keys and the ETL job connected successfully. A couple of follow-ups:
- Can you add a DevOps login with ReadOnly to opsly-staging so our SRE can inspect logs?
- Procurement needs the invoice line item for "Reserved API seats (initial)" to process payment. Rishi — can you share the invoice/SOW reference?

Looking forward to the checklist and rotation notes.

Regards,
Samira Khan
Head of Integrations — Opsly Health
